_note: One line of lore per bestiary stage: sighted, tracked, studied, sealed, bonded. Callum's field notes are in [brackets]. 'quest' marks entries that stay incomplete until a world task is done.

furnaxol.sighted: A small orange axolotl with gills that glow like coals. Smells faintly of a hot oven.
furnaxol.tracked: Lives in the warm runoff pools of Emberwick's glassworks. Follows glassblowers around like a dog that wants a job.
furnaxol.studied: Its belly is a working furnace. It gulps sand, melts it, and blows the glass out as a bubble. [PATCH insists this is 'biologically fine'.]
furnaxol.sealed: Emberwick glassblowers say a Furnaxol that likes you will warm your hands in winter. One that doesn't will warm your eyebrows off.
furnaxol.bonded: It has started blowing small glass figures of its trainer. They are all slightly wrong in the face. [Callum has kept every one.]

cullet.sighted: Taller, lankier, charcoal-grey, with amber seams that glow when it concentrates.
cullet.tracked: Hangs around kilns and juggles marbles. Has been seen wearing goggles it made itself.
cullet.studied: Its belly has become a ribbed portable kiln and its tail a blowpipe. It has stopped being cute and started being competent.
cullet.sealed: Named after the scrap glass that gets melted back down. Takes no insult from this.
cullet.bonded: Will fix a cracked phone screen if you ask nicely. Results vary.

vitric.sighted: A white-hot axolotl in armour made of blue glass. You can see its heart burning through the window in its belly.
vitric.tracked: Rarely seen outside the deepest Emberwick forges. The glassblowers bow when it passes.
vitric.studied: It re-melts and reshapes its own armour mid-fight. Its glass bell can trap a foe or shield a friend.
vitric.sealed: Old Emberwick songs call it the Maestro. Nobody admits to writing the songs.
vitric.bonded: It hums while it works. The hum is in tune. [PATCH: 'I did not program the humming.']

zapail.sighted: A tiny snail with a copper shell and eyestalks shaped like plugs. Twitchy.
zapail.tracked: Leaves a sparkling slime trail that makes your hair stand up. Hikers report socks fused to their feet.
zapail.studied: Rubs its shell on the ground to build static, then panics and discharges it all at once.
zapail.sealed: Considered a pest by the Wayfarers, who keep finding it inside their lanterns.
zapail.bonded: Charges your phone if you leave it nearby overnight. Slowly. [Dani: 'finally a useful one']

tesnail.sighted: The shell has become a segmented copper coil with a gap that crackles.
tesnail.tracked: Drags iron filings into its arc gap and wears them like a beard.
tesnail.studied: Its slime is a conductive ferrofluid that crawls toward magnets. Hit it with lightning and it only gets stronger.
tesnail.sealed: Kettleport dockworkers pay good money to keep one away from the cranes.
tesnail.bonded: Lines its filings up into little patterns when it's happy. One of them looked like a smiley face.

gauslug.sighted: Its shell has split into two parallel rails with a glowing channel between them.
gauslug.tracked: Plants itself on a magnetic foot and does not move for hours. Then fires.
gauslug.studied: A living railgun. It charges for a full turn and launches scrap slugs at speeds PATCH calls 'regrettable'.
gauslug.sealed: The Tally tried to license one as a weapon. The form was never finished.
gauslug.bonded: Lets you hold the slug before it fires. This is a sign of deep trust and also a bad idea.

sprigby.sighted: A tiny wallaby joey with sprouts for ears. It is bouncing. It has not stopped bouncing.
sprigby.tracked: Lives in the low grass around Canopy's tree trunks. The springs in its heels never really switch off.
sprigby.studied: Nervous, but its kick is shockingly strong for the size. Bounces in place when it's scared, which is always.
sprigby.sealed: Canopy kids keep them as pets and use them to jump between rope bridges. Parents are not thrilled.
sprigby.bonded: Calms down a little when its trainer is close. Only a little. [Nolan says it reminds him of his dog.]

fernaroo.sighted: A lean runner with a serrated fern blade for a tail and a seed pouch on its belly.
fernaroo.tracked: Races the gondolas up to the Cloud Station. Usually wins.
fernaroo.studied: The coiled tendons in its legs store wind like a spring. Its tail is sharp enough to trim hedges, which Canopy's gardeners exploit.
fernaroo.sealed: Every Fernaroo has a favourite route and runs it daily. Getting in its way is a mistake.
fernaroo.bonded: Carries small things for you in its pouch. Mostly seeds. Sometimes your keys, uninvited.

scytharoo.sighted: A tall, sleek kickboxer with a scythe of grass for a tail. Stares at you like you owe it money.
scytharoo.tracked: Holds sparring matches at dawn in Canopy's highest clearings. Spectators keep their distance.
scytharoo.studied: Its coil-spring legs give it a first kick nobody can beat. The seed pouch bursts on impact and plants whatever it hits.
scytharoo.sealed: Haydon called it overrated. It kicked a tree over. Haydon still says it's overrated.
scytharoo.bonded: Bows before every fight. Then shows no mercy whatsoever.

gobbin.sighted: A pale-pink shark pup that is mostly head. Its throat glows faintly. It looks worried.
gobbin.tracked: Hides under Kettleport's piers and wears its torn dorsal fin like a cape.
gobbin.studied: Its throat sac flickers right before it bites. Learn the flicker, keep your fingers.
gobbin.sealed: Fishermen call it the Little Goblin. It has never once been happy about it.
gobbin.bonded: Will sleep in a bucket next to your bed. The glow works as a night light.

gulpjaw.sighted: The jaw has outgrown the body. It moves hunched over, like the head is too heavy.
gulpjaw.tracked: Lurks where the harbour drops off into deep water. Its bioluminescent spots blink in patterns.
gulpjaw.studied: A translucent pressure bladder lets it dive deep and fire water in one blast. Its cheeks stretch further than seems legal.
gulpjaw.sealed: Local legend says if you see the spots blink twice, it's laughing at you.
gulpjaw.bonded: Carries things in its cheeks for you. Do not ask for them back.

harrowjaw.sighted: A tall, gaunt stalker in a ragged fin coat. The jaw is most of it.
harrowjaw.tracked: Only surfaces on moonless nights near the Tidal Causeway. Divers refuse to go near the trench.
harrowjaw.studied: It fires its jaw forward on stretched cartilage like a harpoon. Its throat glows through the skin and dims after each shot.
harrowjaw.sealed: Old Hollowfolk charts mark its trench with a single word: 'Don't.'
harrowjaw.bonded: Still terrifying. Now terrifying on your side.

redacted.name: [REDACTED]
redacted.lore: Haydon has a list. This entry is on it. That is all anyone knows.
